2f6e10c.summary: Plays every animation effect in the effects array, either immediately or via a delayed coroutine, and inlines the per-type effect handling (fade, sound, prefab, screen shake).

2f6e1ac.summary: Plays a single animation effect by type: fades sprites/texts, spawns an animation prefab, plays a sound, or starts a screen shake.

2f6e1f4.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for delaying an animation effect.

2f6e27c.summary: Resolves a fade effect by setting start alpha and tweening sprites and texts to the end alpha with delay.

2f6e494.summary: Instantiates the effect's animation prefab at the object's position plus offset and parents it, warning if no prefab is set.

2f6e6dc.summary: Plays the effect's sound clip once through the audio source at sound-effect volume, logging warnings when missing.

2f6e8bc.summary: Finds a CameraShake object and starts its ResolveScreenShake coroutine with the effect's shake info.

2f6eac4.summary: Sets the effect name to the manual description if present, otherwise to the effect type's string name.

2f6eb7c.summary: Initializes the overtime UI by making the icon and splash group transparent and deactivating them.

2f6ec20.summary: Shows the overtime splash, runs a fade in/out tween sequence, and plays the entering-overtime sound.

2f6edf0.summary: Tween callback that deactivates the overtime splash canvas group's game object.

2f731b0.summary: Coroutine that draws an active trap card to the hand position, waits, then adds it to the current hand and sets it up.

2f73478.summary: Coroutine that adds a non-drawn card to the hand if there is room (else sends it to the cemetery), repositions cards, and waits.

2f73718.summary: Coroutine that inserts a non-drawn card into the hand at an index if there is room, repositions cards, and waits.

2f73970.summary: Coroutine that draws the mulligan cards one by one, assigning mulligan options by card category and positioning each with a delay.

2f73cc0.summary: Coroutine that draws a card to the hand position, then adds it to the hand if there is room, otherwise sends it to the cemetery.

2f74140.summary: Coroutine that repositions all hand cards except one excluded card, then waits and clears the animation flag.

2f74390.summary: Coroutine that finishes the mulligan: replaces discarded cards with new ones, animates returns to deck, finalizes UI and fades cards.

2f747d0.summary: Coroutine that repositions every card in the hand with sorting orders, waits, then restores colliders and clears the animation flag.

2f6eee4.summary: Returns the time to draw a card: the player or enemy draw time from global vars depending on isPlayer.

2f6f060.summary: Scales the hand transform by an interpolated small-screen multiplier based on screen diagonal, remembering the original scale.

2f6f1cc.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for adding a drawn card to the hand.

2f6f27c.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for adding an active trap to the hand.

2f6f32c.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for adding a not-drawn card to the hand.

2f6f3dc.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for adding a not-drawn card to the hand at an index.

2f6f494.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for adding cards to the mulligan.

2f6f544.summary: Returns the starting hand size plus any warlord bonus cards for the given side.

2f6f784.summary: Builds an array of unique card IDs for mulligan cards to discard (decompiler merged in discard-setting code).

2f6f868.summary: Validates the discard IDs and marks each mulligan card as discarded or kept; returns whether it was valid.

2f6fb9c.summary: Validates the discard IDs and clicks-select each matching mulligan card at start; returns whether it was valid.

2f6f9fc.summary: Checks that every given card ID exists in the current mulligan, logging an error otherwise (with merged discard-setting code).

2f6fd2c.summary: Creates and returns the coroutine state object for finishing the mulligan.

2f6fe78.summary: Returns a discarded mulligan card to its deck, reparents it, cleans up mulligan frames and re-enables sorting.

2f6ffb0.summary: Moves all mulligan cards into the hand, sets their state and sorting, clears the mulligan list and starts repositioning the hand.

2f70318.summary: Positions a newly drawn mulligan card at its anchor slot, scaling and drawing it, and sets up its collider.

2f70510.summary: Prepares a card for the hand: hides board objects, sets sorting, parents to hand anchor and shows its back for the enemy.

2f70794.summary: Logs and registers a hand effect, then applies it to every card in hand that meets its target criteria (merged with a cleanup loop).

2f70e58.summary: Removes extrinsic hand effects whose enchanting card is the removed card.
